labels.text: Section 6334(a)(2) as increased by section 6334(g): the value of fuel, provisions, furniture, personal effects, arms for personal use, livestock and poultry exempt from levy. Only the published figures of the Revenue Procedures pinned in `us.irc.inflation_adjustments` are recorded (2025: Rev. Proc. 2024-40; 2026: Rev. Proc. 2025-32); other years are outside the declared coverage, so evaluation gives no value rather than an unsourced figure. See TECH-GAPS.md G5605.
Rev. Proc. 2024-40 section 2.50: for calendar year 2025 the value of property exempt from levy under section 6334(a)(2) cannot exceed $11,710
Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 4.49: for calendar year 2026 the value of property exempt from levy under section 6334(a)(2) cannot exceed $11,980
